title: Share watch faces that feature your app's complications

statement.en: Share watch faces that feature your complications to help people discover the app.
statement.ja: appのcomplicationを含むwatch faceを共有し、appの発見を助ける。

conditions: A configured watch face can introduce people to the app and its complications.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Watch faces experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
